ARABIC LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #6 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the difference between ح (Haa) and خ (khaa)? (1 mark)
   A. khaa has a dot above and Haa has none
   B. khaa has a dot below
   C. Haa has a dot above and khaa has none
   D. They are the same letter

2. What is the name of the Arabic letter ك? (1 mark)
   A. DHaa
   B. kaaf
   C. ʿayn
   D. shiin

3. Which Arabic word means "family"? (1 mark)
   A. ابْنٌ
   B. أُسْرَةٌ
   C. أُخْتٌ
   D. جَدَّةٌ

4. What is a good way to give feedback on someone's handwriting? (1 mark)
   A. Laugh at it
   B. Tear the page
   C. Say something good first, then give one tip
   D. Say nothing

5. Which describing word matches the feminine noun taawila (table)? (1 mark)
   A. nadhiif
   B. kabiira
   C. jadiid
   D. kabiir

6. What does at-taawilatu Sagiira mean? (1 mark)
   A. The door is clean.
   B. The table is small.
   C. The table is big.
   D. The chair is new.

7. What does the Arabic sentence الْكُرْسِيُّ جَدِيدٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The table is small.
   B. The window is clean.
   C. The door is big.
   D. The chair is new.

8. Which is the correct spelling of Thursday? (1 mark)
   A. الخمبس
   B. الحميس
   C. الجميس
   D. الخميس

9. Which Arabic word means "tomorrow"? (1 mark)
   A. الْخَمِيسُ
   B. غَدًا
   C. الْيَوْمَ
   D. مَدْرَسَةٌ

10. What does the Arabic sentence عِنْدِي هَدِيَّةٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. We dance.
   B. My mother cooks the food.
   C. I have a gift.
   D. I like the party.

11. Which Arabic word means "birthday"? (1 mark)
   A. لَا
   B. أُغْنِيَةٌ
   C. صَدِيقٌ
   D. عِيدُ مِيلَادٍ

12. Which Arabic sentence means "The banana is delicious." (1 mark)
   A. أَشْرَبُ الشَّايَ
   B. آكُلُ الْأَرُزَّ
   C. جَدَّتِي تُحِبُّنِي
   D. الْمَوْزُ لَذِيذٌ

13. Which Arabic word means "rice"? (1 mark)
   A. لَحْمٌ
   B. سُكَّرٌ
   C. أَرُزٌّ
   D. شَايٌ

14. Which Arabic sentence means "My hand is small." (1 mark)
   A. يَدِي صَغِيرَةٌ
   B. أَغْسِلُ وَجْهِي
   C. أُنَظِّفُ أَسْنَانِي
   D. رَأْسِي كَبِيرٌ

15. Which sentence says 'I clean my teeth'? (1 mark)
   A. aghsilu wajhii
   B. raʾsii kabiir
   C. unadhdhifu asnaanii
   D. aktubu bi-yadii

16. What does the Arabic sentence أَغْسِلُ وَجْهِي mean? (1 mark)
   A. I wash my face.
   B. My hand is small.
   C. My head is big.
   D. I clean my teeth.

17. Which Arabic sentence means "The wind is strong." (1 mark)
   A. هَذِهِ شَمْسٌ
   B. الرِّيحُ قَوِيَّةٌ
   C. الشَّمْسُ حَارَّةٌ
   D. هَذَا مَطَرٌ

18. Which word means 'sun'? (1 mark)
   A. sahaab
   B. riih
   C. matar
   D. shams

19. What does the Arabic sentence أُحِبُّ بَيْتِي mean? (1 mark)
   A. I like my house.
   B. This is my room.
   C. In the room there is a bed.
   D. In the kitchen there is a table.

20. Which Arabic word means "on"? (1 mark)
   A. تَحْتَ
   B. بِجَانِبِ
   C. عَلَى
   D. عِنْدَ

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Give three rules for a handwriting contest. (3 marks) (3 marks)

22. Translate into English: fii l-matbakhi taawila (2 marks)

23. Translate into English: ashrabu sh-shaaya (2 marks)

24. Translate into English: aghsilu wajhii (2 marks)

25. Explain why untidy handwriting can be a problem in Arabic. (2 marks) (2 marks)

26. Give three tips for neat handwriting with good word spacing. (3 marks) (3 marks)

27. Write أُمٌّ and جَدَّةٌ and give the meaning of each. (4 marks) (4 marks)

28. Translate into English: unadhdhifu asnaanii (2 marks)

29. Describe how to draw and label a household item. (4 marks) (4 marks)

30. Translate into English: ʿindii hadiyya (2 marks)

31. Rearrange the words and translate: الْعَصِيرَ / أَشْرَبُ. (2 marks) (2 marks)

32. Explain how the same Arabic word can look different but keep its meaning. (2 marks) (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #6 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — khaa has a dot above and Haa has none
   khaa is Haa with one dot above.

2. B — kaaf
   The letter ك is called kaaf.

3. B — أُسْرَةٌ
   أُسْرَةٌ (usra) means family.

4. C — Say something good first, then give one tip
   Kind and helpful feedback encourages a friend to improve.

5. B — kabiira
   A feminine noun takes the describing word ending in -a.

6. B — The table is small.
   taawila is table and Sagiira means small.

7. D — The chair is new.
   الْكُرْسِيُّ جَدِيدٌ (al-kursiyyu jadiid) means: The chair is new.

8. D — الخميس
   Thursday begins with khaa (خ), which has one dot above.

9. B — غَدًا
   غَدًا (ghadan) means tomorrow.

10. C — I have a gift.
   عِنْدِي هَدِيَّةٌ (ʿindii hadiyya) means: I have a gift.

11. D — عِيدُ مِيلَادٍ
   عِيدُ مِيلَادٍ (ʿiid miilaad) means birthday.

12. D — الْمَوْزُ لَذِيذٌ
   الْمَوْزُ لَذِيذٌ (al-mawzu ladhiidh) means: The banana is delicious.

13. C — أَرُزٌّ
   أَرُزٌّ (aruzz) means rice.

14. A — يَدِي صَغِيرَةٌ
   يَدِي صَغِيرَةٌ (yadii Sagiira) means: My hand is small.

15. C — unadhdhifu asnaanii
   unadhdhifu means I clean and asnaanii means my teeth.

16. A — I wash my face.
   أَغْسِلُ وَجْهِي (aghsilu wajhii) means: I wash my face.

17. B — الرِّيحُ قَوِيَّةٌ
   الرِّيحُ قَوِيَّةٌ (ar-riihu qawiyya) means: The wind is strong.

18. D — shams
   shams means sun.

19. A — I like my house.
   أُحِبُّ بَيْتِي (uhibbu baytii) means: I like my house.

20. C — عَلَى
   عَلَى (ʿalaa) means on.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Everyone writes the same words for the same time; judges look at shape, size, spacing and neatness; everyone is encouraged and praised.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sensible rule.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: In the kitchen there is a table.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: I drink tea.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

24. (2 marks)
   Answer: I wash my face.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

25. (2 marks)
   Answer: Letters that differ only by dots may look the same, so the reader may read the wrong word.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for dots and 1 mark for the wrong reading.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: Leave a gap about one letter wide between words; keep letters in a word joined smoothly; write on the baseline; put dots neatly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid tip.

27. (4 marks)
   Answer: أُمٌّ (umm) means mother and جَدَّةٌ (jadda) means grandmother.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each neat correct word and 1 mark for each meaning.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: I clean my teeth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

29. (4 marks)
   Answer: Draw the item, colour it, write its Arabic name under it from right to left, write the meaning and check the spelling.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: I have a gift.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

31. (2 marks)
   Answer: أَشْرَبُ الْعَصِيرَ. I drink juice.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the order and 1 mark for the translation.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: In different writing styles the letter shapes change a little, but the letters, sounds and meaning stay the same.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for shapes change and 1 mark for meaning stays the same.
